description.de: Fasst alle Quality-Gate-Ergebnisse zu einem Release-Bereitschaftsbericht zusammen
description.en: Summarizes all quality gate results into a release readiness report

config.label: Create the release report
config.command:
Create a structured release readiness report from the following quality gate results:

{{ previous_chain_output }}

Format (Markdown):

## Release Readiness: [APPROVED / BLOCKED / WITH RESERVATIONS]

| Gate | Status | Details |
|------|--------|---------|
| <one row per quality gate or product found in the results, named as there> | ... | ... |

## Summary
Short assessment in 2-3 sentences.

## Next steps
- Concrete recommendations based on the gate results

Use the gate_status values from the outputs: GREEN = ✅, YELLOW = ⚠️, RED = ❌.
If no gate_status was found, analyze the output yourself.

Overall status:
- APPROVED: all gates GREEN
- WITH RESERVATIONS: at least one YELLOW, no RED
- BLOCKED: at least one RED
